newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Minor earth tremor hits Sarajevo.
newsitem.headline: Minor earth tremor hits Sarajevo.

text.p: A minor earth tremor measuring 2.9 on the Richter scale shook the Bosnian capital Sarajevo on Wednesday morning but there were no reports of casualties or damage, a seismologist said.
The epicentre of the tremor was 16 km (10 miles) southwest of Sarajevo, said Almir Babic of the state seismology institute.
The quake shook buildings in outlying villages and towns around Sarajevo at about 8 a.m. (0700 GMT). It followed two minor tremors last week in the city which caused no major damage.
